Chi Sono? Who Am I? Wer Bin Ich? Chi Sono? * Who Am I? * Wer Bin Ich? * Chi Sono? * Who Am I? * Wer Bin Ich? *

I'm a young German/Italian web designer, motion designer, and video maker with an incurable passion for anything creative or techy. I'm not one to stick to a single lane: if there's something new to try, I'm already halfway there – whether it's designing a website, animating a video, or getting my hands dirty with a hands-on project (literally, I don't mind a bit of mess).

Honestly, defining myself is a challenge. Why settle for one label when you can have a whole collection? If I could, I'd do everything in life – because why limit yourself to just one flavor when there's a whole buffet out there?

I like to think of myself as a Swiss Army knife: versatile, endlessly curious, and always ready to pull out the right tool for the job (or at least I give it a try).

So, if you're looking for someone who's allergic to boredom and always up for a new adventure – whether digital or analog – you've just found your guy.
